chapter: Pedal points, Hampton, Norvo and Debut
title: A New Haven concert with Benny Goodman, Hampton and Mel Powell
summary: Johnson recalls hearing Mingus in a joint Goodman-Hampton concert; Mel Powell's turn to classical music.

story.theme_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the leader and his bands
story.community_name: Working for Benny Goodman: the perfectionist bandleader

blocks.x: I think I saw you during that period. Did you -- you came and played a concert at -- in New Haven with Benny Goodman and Mel Powell was there.
Yeah, man. That's a long time ago.
Yeah, I was there then, that evening. That was a very good concert, but I just remember that it started off with Mel Powell, --
That's right. He could play (inaudible). was studying classical music then, wasn't he?
Yeah, I think he studied with Hindemann.
You sure got a good memory, man.
Yeah, well, that was -- I just enjoyed that night enormously. But I just remembered Lionel Hampton, it said, Benny Goodman brought his drummer, --
And it was Charlie Perry, I think. And then Lionel Hampton, he said that he was bringing his bass player from the band.
Yeah, That's weird. I remember that, man.
